name: What should I consider when choosing new windows for my home?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing new windows for my home?

acceptedAnswer.text: When selecting new windows, consider material (vinyl for durability/cost, wood for traditional aesthetics, fiberglass for strength/efficiency), glass type (double-pane for insulation, low-E coatings for UV protection), and style (casement, double-hung, slider). Energy efficiency ratings like U-factor and Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) are also crucial, especially in the Bay Area's varied climate. We help you balance budget, aesthetics, and performance to find the best fit.
acceptedAnswer.description: When choosing new windows, consider material, glass type, style, and energy efficiency ratings like U-factor and SHGC to meet your home's needs and budget.
